info.name: OCR Flow
info.summary: Send files and folders to the OCR pipeline (Google Vision, tesseract, MiniMax) from the Files context menu
info.description: Adds "Send to OCR", "Re-OCR anyway", and "Scan folder" actions to the Files context menu (single and multi-select). Files are queued to the nc-ocr-flow service running on the same host; progress is visible at /panel on port 8095.
info.author: Likivik
